description: This file defines a base class for handling guardrails associated with OpenAI models. It includes a method to extract the last user message(s) from a list of message dictionaries, with auxiliary logic for message content conversion.

classes.name: OpenAIGuardrailBase
classes.description: A base class for implementing guardrail logic specific to OpenAI models, primarily providing functionality to extract user prompts from message histories.

methods.name: Optional[str] get_user_prompt(self, messages: List["AllMessageValues"])
methods.description: Retrieves the last block of consecutive user messages from a list of message dictionaries, concatenating their content into a single string or returning None if no user messages are found.
